title: No preset-count bound before u16 narrowing: >65535 lane_presets silently wraps default_preset_idx / preset_index
detail: The loader bounds preset VALUES but never the row COUNT; past 65535 rows u16(i) wraps, so the default preset (E5 fallback, dial resting position, sparse-serialization def_w baseline) silently resolves to a wrong row.
recommended_fix: Reject lane_presets when len > 65535 at catalog load (or widen the index type), so the u16 narrowing can never wrap silently.

title: Non-string default_lane_preset is silently ignored (falls back to preset 0) instead of rejected
detail: A type-typo (e.g. "default_lane_preset": 5) makes jstr return "", silently selecting row 0, while an unknown-string value is rejected ("not found") — inconsistent with the loader's strict-typing fail-fast bar (ODN-5).
recommended_fix: Assert the value is a json.String and reject otherwise before resolving; keep the empty-string/absent sentinel as the explicit no-default case.
